name: LoongArch64
description: LoongArch64 architecture plugin with disassembly and LLIL lifting.
longdescription:
Plugin written in Python. It is laggy with ELF files bigger than 100 KB (Binja might crash). For bugs/issues, open an issue on my [repo](https://github.com/noah0x1/LoongArch64-Binary-Ninja-Binja-Plug-in).

Parts of this plugin were written with AI. In version 0.2.0 I will rewrite those parts by hand.

Right now it only supports Linux (LoongArch64 is mainly used with Linux), but macOS support is planned (Windows maybe). I also want to port it to C++ later so it runs much faster. I started with Python so I can keep learning with Python, since I've never really coded in high-level programming languages before.

Please don't use version 0.1.0 for commercial work. It is only a "beta" right now.

!!!THIS IS A PYTHON I'VE MADE AN ACCIDENT I WILL MAKE THIS LATER A C++ VERSION IF YOU WANT TO HAVE THE PYTHON VERSION GO ON MY [repo](https://github.com/noah0x1/LoongArch64-Binary-Ninja-Binja-Plug-in) <--!!!
